description:
An outdoor ring in the north-east of the dock city brings spectators, betting and ordinary work animals into an uneasy public spectacle. Machop drives forward and Hitmonlee answers with kicks while ropes jerk and sailors lean closer. Their alternating overworld lunges are a staged display; the player challenges a separately generated sailor’s team through Harker. The spectators’ bets do not create a player betting system.

A challenger offers one to three distinct, level-legal species from a curated roster of shore workers, scavengers and brawlers. The size follows the able party up to three opponents; levels sit one to three below the able party’s median, with a floor of one. Each selection favors previously seen species with an 80/20 seen/unseen draw, falling back to the eligible pool if one bucket is empty. Legendary, mythical, Ultra Beast and pseudo-legendary candidates are excluded from both pools, as are alternate forms, species with a base-stat total of 600 or more, and candidates without a damaging move at that level. Seeing a species elsewhere does not make it eligible. These are current balancing choices.

Harker keeps one saved offer for fifteen real minutes. Changing the able party can rebalance its team without extending the clock; reloading does not provide a new draw. A generated challenger’s display name is not an identity for a recurring resident, even when the name happens to be Venn.
